answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents stake tokens to enter an audit graph. In this decentralized meadow, game-theoretic multi-agent auditing selects committee cuts across network topologies. If topological cut verifications detect colluding clones attempting to plume fake identities, their bonded stake is slashed. Every validator retains an immutable cryptographic relic proving honest audit history, enforcing superlinear attacker cost as subverting cuts scales with O(n^2).
